note: The two sets are nearly identical in content and accuracy: both correctly capture the second-order response, ωφn and ζφ expressions, the Region 3 negative damping from the generator-torque controller, the negative ∂P/∂θ sensitivity, the PI gain formulas, and the Ref. [10] design targets. Set B, however, repeats the generator-torque negative-damping claim twice (under 'damping effect on speed error response' and 'damping effect in speed error response'), adding nothing but redundancy. Set A therefore has the same correct coverage with one fewer duplicate. Both sets also share the same internal duplication of the ζφ and ωφn design targets stated under both 'rotor-speed error response' and 'blade-pitch controller' names.
remarks: Both sets omit several engineering statements on the page: the derivative term increases effective drivetrain inertia, the proportional term adds damping, the integral term adds restoring, the negative damping must be compensated by the proportional term of the blade-pitch controller, and Ref. [10] recommends neglecting the derivative gain and ignoring the generator-torque negative damping. Both also state the ζφ = 0.6–0.7 and ωφn = 0.6 rad/s targets twice under different entity names. The text layer garbles the equation symbols (e.g., '2 K M' where the image shows 2Mφωφn), so formula claims should be checked against the rendered equations.
